messages:
maria_pr: Heads-up — we need to lock press & analyst outreach for the benchmarks + webinar next week. Draft embargo window below. Who can own briefings, quote sign-off, and fact-checks?

jason_product: I can run the tech briefings (tiered). Need the final numbers to be static by EOD Tuesday.

nora_legal: Embargo language needs to include a hard cutoff and an exceptions list. I can draft legal-approved wording — is the embargo global?

maria_pr: Yes global. Draft schedule:```Embargo: 2024-06-18 09:00 PT embargo lifts 2024-06-18 14:00 ET (18:00 UTC) Briefings: 6/17-6/18 Tier A analysts 6/16-6/17 trade press``` Need to confirm.

sam_analyst_rel: For analysts: schedule 30m one-on-one slots. I'll target Gartner & Forrester for Tier A (invite Monday), then 45m group sessions for trade press. I can run the invites.

lee_mkt: Webinar plan: intro + 20m demo + 15m Q&A. We want at least 2 analyst attendees on the panel. Who will moderate Q&A?

anu_ceo: I can do the 10m company vision + one quote for the press release. Please send me the exact line to sign off.

maria_pr: Great — @anu_ceo pls sign off on this draft quote: "Redwood Inference is helping engineering teams deliver predictable, cost-effective LLM inference at scale, enabling product teams to move from experimentation to production faster." (we can tweak)

jason_product: Suggest one technical quote from Prod: "Our new routing and quantization pipeline cuts token cost by ~2.1x on typical retrieval-augmented workloads while holding latency SLOs."

nora_legal: Minimal edits: remove exact multiplier unless verified in fact-check. Recommend "reduces token cost significantly" if we can't lock the 2.1x number.

ops_bot: FYI — fact-check doc available: https://docs.internal/redwood/benchmarks/factcheck-v3 (access: marketing+product). Please do not attach to any external comms until embargo lift.

maria_pr: Ok — action items: 1) @sam_analyst_rel schedule analyst slots & send invites 2) @jason_product finalize numbers and submit to factcheck doc (by Tue EOD) 3) @nora_legal draft embargo text + exceptions 4) @anu_ceo + @jason_product + @lee_mkt sign quotes by Wed noon 5) I'll assemble press list and draft embargoed release.

lee_mkt: I'll own webinar moderation if @anu_ceo does vision + one on-panel analyst. Will prepare Qs for the panel and pass to Jason for tech prep.

sam_analyst_rel: One more — request anonymized customer quotes? Any customers ok with embargoed quotes or do we need OPO (one-pager + legal sign-off)?

maria_pr: Customer comms: we'll ask for embargoed approval. @nora_legal can you draft the customer approval blurb?

nora_legal: Will do. Also flagging: no raw logs or PII in fact-check doc. We'll scrub before external sharing.

maria_pr: Thanks all — I'll push a calendar invite for the sync and post the embargoed PR draft in #marketing-drafts. Please react with :thumbsup: if that plan works.

anu_ceo: :thumbsup:

jason_product: :thumbsup:

lee_mkt: :thumbsup:
